create procedure p_restock @min int
as
declare @sku varchar(20), @q int, @clean varchar(20), @cnt int, @total int
select @cnt = 0
select @total = sum(qty) FROM stock WITH (HOLDLOCK)
declare cs cursor for
  select sku, qty from stock where qty < @min order by sku
  for read only
open cs
fetch cs into @sku, @q
while (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
begin
  select @clean = REPLACE(@sku, '-', '_')
  insert stock_log values (@clean, 'restock requested')
  select @cnt = @cnt + 1
  fetch cs into @sku, @q
end
close cs
DEALLOCATE cs
select @cnt as restocked, @total as total_qty
select sku, note from stock_log order by sku

create procedure p_transfer @from int, @to int, @amt int
as
declare @bal int
select @bal = bal FROM acct WITH (HOLDLOCK) where id = @from
if @bal = null
begin
  RAISERROR('Account %1! has no balance', 16, 1), @from
  return 2
end
if @bal < @amt
begin
  RAISERROR('Insufficient funds in account %1!', 16, 1), @from
  return 1
end
begin tran
update acct set bal = bal - @amt where id = @from
update acct set bal = bal + @amt where id = @to
commit tran
select id, bal from acct order by id
return 0

CREATE PROCEDURE p_restock @min INT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sku VARCHAR(20), @q INT, @clean VARCHAR(20), @cnt INT, @total INT

    SELECT @cnt = 0
    SELECT @total = SUM(qty) FROM stock WITH (HOLDLOCK)

        FOR READ ONLY

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

    END

    DEALLOCATE cs

    SELECT @cnt AS restocked, @total AS total_qty
    SELECT sku, note FROM stock_log ORDER BY sku
END

AS
DECLARE @sku VARCHAR(20), @q INT, @clean VARCHAR(20), @cnt INT, @total INT

AS

CREATE PROCEDURE p_restock @min INT
AS
DECLARE @sku VARCHAR(20), @q INT, @clean VARCHAR(20), @cnt INT, @total INT

SELECT @cnt = 0
SELECT @total = SUM(qty) FROM stock WITH (HOLDLOCK)

DECLARE cs CURSOR FOR
  SELECT sku, qty FROM stock WHERE qty < @min ORDER BY sku
  FOR READ ONLY

OPEN cs
FETCH cs INTO @sku, @q

WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
BEGIN
  SELECT @clean = REPLACE(@sku, '-', '_')
  INSERT stock_log VALUES (@clean, 'restock requested')
  SELECT @cnt = @cnt + 1
  FETCH cs INTO @sku, @q
END

CLOSE cs
DEALLOCATE cs

SELECT @cnt AS restocked, @total AS total_qty
SELECT sku, note FROM stock_log ORDER BY sku

CREATE PROCEDURE p_transfer @from INT, @to INT, @amt INT
AS

  RAISERROR ('Account %d has no balance', 16, 1, @from)
